gw_started=false gw_ready=false gw_ended=false
 gw_points=0 gw_damage=0 gw_level=0
if gw_started and level==gw_level then gw_ended=true end
if gw_started and level==gw_level then gw_damage=100-f.hp end

if gw_started and level==gw_level and not gw_ended then
  gw_points+=n
 end

mode = gw_request and max(1,gw_request-2) or choose_mode()
  gw_request=nil

-- environment: native minigame entry and narrow semantic gpio transport
function gw_start()
 local req=peek(0x5f80)
 if not gw_started and req>0 then
  gw_started=true gw_level=req gw_request=req
  srand(peek2(0x5fa0))
  level=req-1 mode=nil
  add_player(0)
  coroutines={}
  add_cr(function()
   state=state_coach yield() state=state_pinbot
   while state~=state_play do yield() end
   add_cr(run_coach)
  end)
  add_cr(run_pinbot)
  add_cr(run_platforms)
 end
end
function gw_publish()
 if gw_started and level==gw_level and state==state_play
   and pbstate==pbstate_move then gw_ready=true end
 poke(0x5f81,state) poke(0x5f82,level)
 poke(0x5f83,mode or 0) poke(0x5f84,playercount)
 poke2(0x5f85,score)
 if players[0] then
  poke2(0x5f87,players[0].pos.x*100)
  poke2(0x5f89,players[0].pos.y*100)
 end
 poke(0x5f8b,boss and boss.hp or 0)
 poke(0x5f8c,gw_ready and 1 or 0)
 poke(0x5f8d,gw_ended and 1 or 0)
 poke(0x5f8e,promptvisible and 1 or 0)
 poke(0x5f8f,gw_level)
 poke2(0x5f90,gw_points)
 poke(0x5f92,gw_damage)
 poke(0x5f93,dialog and 1 or 0)
 poke(0x5f94,tutorialon and 1 or 0)
 poke(0x5f95,pbstate or 0)
 poke(0x5f96,#targets)
 gw_obs()
end
-- policy observation block: pins 23..31 and 34..127 (read-only to the game)
function gw_pk(a,x,y)
 local u=mid(0,flr(x*8)+2048,4095)
 local v=mid(0,flr(y*8)+2048,4095)
 poke(a,u%256) poke(a+1,u\256+v%16*16) poke(a+2,v\16)
end
function gw_vb(a,v,k)
 poke(a,mid(1,flr(v*k)+128,255))
end
function gw_p2(a,v,k)
 poke2(a,mid(0,flr(v*k)+16384,32767))
end
function gw_obs()
 local b,f,n,k,m,a=players[0],0,0,0,mode,0x5fb0
 if b then
  gw_p2(0x5f97,b.pos.x-b.prev.x,256)
  gw_p2(0x5f99,b.pos.y-b.prev.y,256)
 end
 local d=dialog
 if d and (d.len>=#d.txt or promptvisible) then f+=1 end
 if m==mode_bro and bro and bro.hit then f+=2 end
 if brointerrupt then f+=4 end
 for i=1,2 do
  local p,q=platforms[i],0x5fa2+i*7-7
  if p.enabled then f+=4<<i end
  poke(q,p.x) poke(q+1,p.w) poke(q+2,p.h)
  gw_p2(q+3,p.y,64) gw_p2(q+5,p.vy,256)
 end
 memset(0x5fb0,0,80)
 if m==mode_bowl or m==mode_boss then
  n=min(#pins,10)
  for i=1,n do
   local p=pins[i]
   gw_pk(a,p.x,p.y) poke(a+3,p.w) poke(a+4,p.h) a+=5
   if p.isknocked then k+=1<<(i-1) end
  end
  if m==mode_boss and boss then
   gw_pk(0x5fe2,boss.x,boss.y)
   poke(0x5fe5,boss.w) poke(0x5fe6,boss.h)
   poke(0x5fe7,boss.hp) poke(0x5fe8,mid(0,flr(boss.shake*32),255))
  end
 elseif m==mode_breakfast then
  n=min(#eggs,10)
  if n>0 then poke(a,eggs[1].w) poke(a+1,eggs[1].h) end
  a+=2
  for i=1,n do
   local e=eggs[i]
   gw_pk(a,e.x,e.y) gw_vb(a+3,e.vx,8) gw_vb(a+4,e.vy,8) a+=5
   if e.isknocked then k+=1<<(i-1) end
  end
  if pan then
   gw_pk(0x5fe4,pan.x,pan.y) poke(0x5fe7,pan.w) poke(0x5fe8,pan.h)
   gw_vb(0x5fe9,pan.x-(gw_px or pan.x),32) gw_px=pan.x
  end
  poke(0x5f9d,min(#yolks,255))
  if yolks[1] then poke(0x5fea,yolks[1].w) poke(0x5feb,yolks[1].h) end
  for i=1,min(#yolks,4) do
   local y=yolks[i]
   a=0x5fec+i*5-5
   gw_pk(a,y.x,y.y) gw_vb(a+3,y.vx,16) gw_vb(a+4,y.vy,16)
  end
 elseif m==mode_breakout then
  n=#bricks
  for r in all(bricks) do
   local g=r.gi
   if g then
    local o=a+g\8
    poke(o,peek(o)|(1<<(g%8)))
    gw_p2(a+5+g\5*2,r.y,64)
    poke(a+21+g%5,r.x) poke(a+26,r.w) poke(a+27,r.h)
   end
  end
 elseif m==mode_bb and hoop then
  b=balls[1]
  gw_pk(a,hoop.x,hoop.y) poke(a+3,hoop.h) poke(a+4,netw)
  poke(a+5,hoop.flash and 1 or 0)
  poke(a+6,b and b.bbstate or 0)
  gw_p2(a+7,hoop.y-(gw_hy or hoop.y),256) gw_hy=hoop.y
 elseif m==mode_barber then
  n=min(#targets,7)
  for i=1,n do
   local t=targets[i]
   gw_pk(a,t.x,t.y) poke(a+3,t.w) poke(a+4,t.h) a+=5
   if t.isknocked then k+=1<<(i-1) end
  end
 end
 if m~=mode_bb then gw_hy=nil end
 if m~=mode_breakfast then gw_px=nil end
 poke(0x5f9b,f) poke(0x5f9c,n)
 poke(0x5f9e,k%256) poke(0x5f9f,k\256)
end
